COMPUTER VISION · EXPERIMENTAL MEASUREMENT

Gecko-Inspired Adhesive Contact Measurement

An image-processing workflow to measure the contact area of a gecko-inspired adhesive sample on glass.

Project overview

I developed a computer-vision workflow for measuring the contact area of a gecko-inspired adhesive against a glass surface using a fixed camera.

Engineering approach

  • Image preprocessing and optional lens correction.
  • Detection and segmentation of the specimen and contact regions.
  • Geometric validation of the detected material region.
  • Pixel-to-area calibration to estimate contact area.

The workflow is designed to support repeatable experimental measurement. The final page can be expanded with validated images, calibration details and measurement results.
